description: Animate React and Vue components with Animate UI (Motion-based primitives for Radix UI, Base UI, React Aria and reka-ui). For shadcn/ui or shadcn-vue components, runs the `@animate-ui/cli` codemod that swaps their primitives for Animate UI's; for components built directly on those libraries, swaps the import to `@animate-ui/react` or `@animate-ui/vue`; for anything else (custom components, plain markup), applies Animate UI's motion rules, tokens (springs, curves, scales, blur) and recipes with Motion. Also reviews existing motion with the `audit` command, migrates Animate UI v1 projects, and turns any icon (Lucide, Hugeicons, Tabler, a custom SVG…) into an animated icon compatible with `AnimateIcon`. Use when asked to animate a component, make shadcn "animated", add enter/exit, press or swap animations, animate page transitions, set up Animate UI in a React, Vue or Nuxt project, animate an icon, change the animation pace, review whether motion follows Animate UI's rules, or find slow and janky animations.
